question: Which freedom fighter is remembered for his efforts in achieving the official language of India as Hindi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Purushottam Das Tandon**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Purushottam Das Tandon** is remembered for his significant efforts in advocating for Hindi as the official language of India.
 
• He was an Indian freedom fighter and a staunch supporter of the Hindi language.
 
• His efforts were instrumental in the adoption of Hindi as the official language in the Indian Constitution.
 
• He served as the President of the Indian National Congress and was awarded the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian award, in 1961.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Purushottam Das Tandon** was born on 1 August 1882 in Allahabad, Uttar Pradesh.
 
• He was actively involved in the Indian independence movement and worked closely with Mahatma Gandhi.
 
• Tandon played a crucial role in promoting Hindi and was a key figure in the Hindi Sahitya Sammelan, an organization dedicated to the promotion of Hindi literature.
 
• He was also a member of the Constituent Assembly of India, where he strongly advocated for Hindi to be the national language.
 
• His dedication to the cause earned him the title "Rajarshi," meaning "Royal Saint."
